opening.argument: The presentation actively solicits Bitcoin deposits into Mirror Trading International by presenting participation as a simple path to passive income. Viewers are told to “drop 100 bucks in here” and are promised they “will be paid over, and over, and over every Saturday” through the binary network. Qualification depends on funding a trading account and personally referring at least one person on both the left and right, while participants are directed to send funds to the trading pool for daily passive income. The closing slide then supplies a direct “Join now” call to action. These features promote entry into a recruitment-dependent investment structure, rather than merely discussing or investigating one.
